items.title: Non-Retryable Errors
items.description: Mark error types that will never succeed — such as validation failures or missing records — so Temporal fails fast instead of retrying indefinitely.

items.title: Parallel Execution
items.description: Executes multiple Activities concurrently for maximum throughput with error handling and controlled parallelism.

items.title: Pick First Pattern
items.description: Races multiple Activities in parallel, returns the first completed result, and cancels the remaining Activities using SDK cancellation scopes.

items.title: Priority
items.description: Assigns a priority level to Workflows and Activities so that time-sensitive work dispatches ahead of lower-priority work within a single Task Queue.

items.title: QoS & Throughput Patterns

items.title: Request-Response via Updates

items.title: Resumable Activity (AKA Pause On Failure)
items.description: Park the Workflow after retries are exhausted and wait for a human to signal a correction, then resume execution from where it left off.

items.title: Retry Alerting via Metrics
items.description: Emit a metric from the Activity when attempts cross a threshold, so on-call teams see persistent failures before an SLA breach.

items.title: Saga Pattern
items.description: Manages distributed transactions with compensating actions. Each step has a compensation that undoes its effects if subsequent steps fail.

items.title: Signal with Start Pattern
items.description: Starts a Workflow when Signaling it if it does not already exist. If already running, it receives the Signal directly.

items.title: Sliding Window
items.description: Maintains a fixed number of concurrently active Child Workflows, starting a new one each time an existing one completes.
